scope_statement: User-discovered generated-plot axis readability defects in Insertion Loss Tool.

escaped_defects.user_symptom: Generated and Modify plots show mechanically divided decimal labels such as 13.34 GHz and -4.56 dB with no engineering significance.
escaped_defects.failure_mechanism: The renderer divided the exact min-max span into a fixed number of equal intervals instead of selecting engineering-friendly steps.
